patterns: APPSC asks scheme-purpose identification: e-PDS distributes food grains to BPL families; Vidya Deevena covers 100% college fees.
Full-form items recur (DWCRA = Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas).
Statement-based scheme items (Vidya Deevena categories, Badugu Vikasam target group and date) and funding partner (APRIGP = World Bank).
App MCQs track 2025-26 budgets/SES figures and newer schemes (Stree Shakti, Disha Bill withdrawal), more numeric than PYQs.
